title: the no-retro-red arm judges a fixture berth beside the live corpus
intention: build_inspector's no-retro-red arm judges a fixture pre-writes_to decompose berth beside the live chart corpus, so it reads the same on a box that has charted nothing.
why: Measured 2026-11-13 on akienasus: the arm read ZERO standing decompose berths at /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart (berths stand only on the charting box) and its corpus>0 guard redded test_inspector.py.
traces_to: Law 8 (a proof reads the same on every box) and Law 5 (berths are instance-space).
how: In test_inspector.py's NO RETRO-RED arm, write one decompose packet to the proof's tmp (sub_problems with one piece and no writes_to key) and judge it before the live glob over saved_berths; corpus and silent count both; the corpus>0 and silent>0 guards stand.

clauses.claim: test_inspector.py is green on akienasus, which holds no chart berths
the fixture berth is judged: a judge_decompose that names writes_to on a pre-field berth reds the arm

decisions.text: D1: the no-retro-red arm judges a tmp pre-writes_to decompose fixture, then the live glob.

measured.saw: AssertionError: the no-retro-red arm read ZERO standing decompose berths at /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart
